title: TheoryInput
description: Input contract for a single scientific theory consumed by ttm-model-foundry. Section 12 of the build brief.

theory_id.description: Stable identifier of the theory, e.g. T01.

parent_kernel_id.description: Identifier of the upstream kernel that produced this theory.

core_claim.description: Verbatim statement of the central mechanistic claim.

distinctive_falsifiable_prediction.description: Required and non-empty. The Ontologist converts this into M's pre-registered falsification signatures.

what_would_falsify_it.description: Required and non-empty. The Ontologist converts this into M's pre-registered falsification signatures.
